item.title: The end is near (my rat and I both have lung problems)
item.description: This is Choso and he has a chronic respiratory issue that he’s been medicated for- but he needs more. He’s one of my only reasons for living I have a type of vasculitis called EGPA and have been dealing with a relapse in my sinuses, this decided to happen while I am uninsured and waiting for my appeal to be reviewed! So I love it, and it’s great and i am having a great time. I get recurrent sinusitis and have needed two surgeries bc of it. I’ve been so sick for a while, and the infection has made its way to my lungs. Sigh… I’ve posted on here a lot, and I dilate that it’s under these circumstances and I always hope that I’ll have better news… It’s just really bad right now. Choso needs a nebulizer, I need some meds and some help seeing my pulmonologist… I know times are like, insane for everyone. I hate to be in this position I feel so powerless. The way my mental health has just plummeted because of all f this… I’m so limited in what I can do these days from the illness, the rats deserve a better mom, idk. I keep telling myself “the only way out is through” I’m sharing my ko fi link: https://ko-fi.com/darkratlord/goal?g=0 And direct PyaPal: @sillygooseinc But any good vibes and wishing of luck is appreciated…. My babies are all I have, and it is especially Choso I care about. This community has been there for me and I’m so so thankful. I have a social worker helping me too, she helped with my appeal and whatnot and has helped a lot of people who got booted off Medicaid. Anyways. If you stuck around to read this, I appreciate it, thank you. Have a good one and kiss your animals for me if you have any.
